title: Omnia renderer-safe provider attempt lineage receipt
description: A bounded, content-free projection of one immutable provider-attempt lineage fact. This receipt is safe for renderer diagnostics and exports: it contains opaque identifiers, revisions and hashes only, never raw URLs, credentials, headers, cookies, prompts, responses, reasoning, attachment bytes, request bodies or local paths.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the renderer-safe receipt contract.

lineageFactId.description: Opaque identifier of the immutable native lineage fact.

frozenProviderInputId.description: Opaque identifier of the exact frozen provider-input preparation.

providerProfileId.description: Opaque provider profile identifier; no credential reference is included.

modelId.description: Provider/model identifier used by the frozen input.

providerDefinitionSchemaVersion.description: The supported frozen provider-definition schema version.

providerDefinitionSha256.description: Lower-case SHA-256 address of the frozen provider definition.

endpointFingerprintSha256.description: Domain-separated endpoint fingerprint; the raw endpoint is intentionally absent.

requestedEffort.description: Explicit Omnia effort requested by the caller, or null when unknown.

effectiveEffort.description: Effort applied by policy/adapter, preserved as bounded provider-native evidence, or null when not recorded.

resolvedParametersSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact canonical resolved parameters.

inputContentSha256.description: Content address of the prepared input; input bytes are not included.

createdAtMs.description: Durable preparation timestamp in positive Unix milliseconds, copied from the frozen input.
